title: How the app finds the key that checks the signature
desc: Two parties: ExampleCRM and the OP. Step 1: ExampleCRM fetches the OP's discovery document at /.well-known/openid-configuration, which lists the jwks_uri address. Step 2: ExampleCRM fetches the JWKS from jwks_uri and gets the OP's public keys, each with a kid. Step 3: the token's header says which kid signed it. Step 4: when ExampleCRM sees a kid it does not have, it fetches the JWKS again. A note says an app with a stale or hardcoded key rejects every new token with invalid signature, usually the morning after a rotation.
